question: What event at the moment of bodily death marks the culminating release described here?
premises: The time of body-fall is specified
The skull is said to split
inference: At the fall of the body, when the skull splits, that decisive moment occurs.
uncertainties: kapālambhidyate is transmitted as a fused form and may be read as kapālam bhidyate
plain_english: O Goddess, when the body falls and the skull is split, then that occurs.
